# InfinityLoop

<Badge type="danger" text="error" /> <Badge type="tip" text="on by default" /> 

Group: [Probable bugs](/rules/#probable-bugs) · PhpStorm name: `InfinityLoopInspection`

A method whose only statement calls the very same method on `$this`,
`self` or `static` recurses unconditionally until the stack overflows —
typically a getter/proxy that was meant to call a property, a parent method
or a differently named method.

## Example

```php{8,13,19,34}
<?php
class Settings
{
    private $theme;

    public function theme()
    {
        return $this->theme();
    }

    public static function boot($env)
    {
        static::boot($env);
    }

    protected function flush()
    {
        // delegate
        self::flush();
    }

    public function locale()
    {
        return $this->theme;
    }

    public function reload()
    {
        return parent::reload();
    }

    public function save()
    {
        return $this->Save();
    }

    public function sync()
    {
        return ($this->sync());
    }

    public function close($n)
    {
        if ($n > 0) {
            return $this->close($n - 1);
        }
    }
}
```

Reported:

<ul>
<li>line 8: Method calls itself unconditionally; this recursion never ends.</li>
<li>line 13: Method calls itself unconditionally; this recursion never ends.</li>
<li>line 19: Method calls itself unconditionally; this recursion never ends.</li>
<li>line 34: Method calls itself unconditionally; this recursion never ends.</li>
</ul>

## Configure

In [`custos.json`](/guide/configuration):

```json
{
  "rules": {
    "InfinityLoop": {
      "enabled": false
    }
  }
}
```

## Suppress

Before the statement or declaration (or the first statement of the file), either of:

```php
// @custos-ignore InfinityLoop

/**
 * @noinspection InfinityLoopInspection
 */
```
